ns2:section.sectionText: Most of this course will be very flexible in timing to accommodate students' schedules. There are two fixed times for the midterm and the final exam. The midterm exam will be held on May 28, 2021 from approximately 5-7pm CDT and the final exam will be held on June 11, 2021 from approximately 5-7pm CDT. All exams will be taken online using ProctorU. ProctorU is an online proctoring service that allows students to take exams remotely. Students will be responsible for the ProctorU exam charges (paid directly to ProctorU)~ cost is pending, but will follow the typical ProctorU pricing structure. This course will use Moodle.
